headline: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, Trilegal act on Cult.fit ₹950 crore+ proposed IPO
sum: Cult.Fit Limited has proposed an initial public offering of equity shares, consisting of a fresh issue aggregating up to ₹950 crore and an offer for sale by the selling shareholders aggregating up to 178,609,200 equity shares of face value…
detail: Cult.Fit Limited has proposed an initial public offering of equity shares, consisting of a fresh issue aggregating up to ₹950 crore and an offer for sale by the selling shareholders aggregating up to 178,609,200 equity shares of face value by ₹1 each. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is advising Cult.Fit on this IPO. The Capital Markets team advising the Issuer is led by Tanvi Kini (Partner). The general corporate team advising the Issuer is led by Sharada Ramachandra (Partner).
